          sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh
          # For UPSTREAM use Dockerfile for upstream contents

issues.test_name: [It] [bc-serial] PTP e2e tests PTP ClockSync Slave can sync to master [Serial]
issues.ai_summary:
---

**TL;DR:** PTP slave clock-sync timeouts across all suites point to a lab-wide GM/infrastructure failure during this nightly run.

**Overall Issue Class:** infra_timeout
**Overall Severity:** HIGH

## Root Causes (18 failures across 7 suites)

### 14/18 failures — PTP slave clock synchronization timeout
- **Suites:** bc, dualfollower, dualnicbc, dualnicbcha, oc | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** Slave nodes never reached LOCKED state within ~208–296s polling windows; the identical timeout signature across all five suites simultaneously on the same cluster run confirms a lab-wide GM/network-path failure, not a per-suite code regression.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** yes — same tests pass in other runs; cross-suite simultaneity is the infra-flake signature
- **Fix:** Investigate PTP grandmaster hardware and network path health in the telco5g lab at the time of this run (2026-08-11 ~04:06 UTC) and re-run once stability is confirmed.

### 3/18 failures — TGM WPC hardware not present on test cluster
- **Suites:** tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN (bc/dualfollower/dualnicbc skip same tests cleanly; tgm suite errors instead)
- **What:** The three WPC T-GM/GNSS tests require physical GNSS hardware; without it the tgm BeforeEach fails hard rather than skipping, producing errors where other suites produce skips.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** no — deterministic missing-hardware failure
- **Fix:** Provision a WPC T-GM node with GNSS for the nightly cluster, or add a graceful skip guard in the tgm suite BeforeEach when GM hardware is absent.

kind: Role

roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

  name: privileged-rights

metadata:

  namespace: openshift-ptp
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  serviceAccountName: builder
  containers:
    - name: priv
      image: quay.io/podman/stable:v4.9.4
      command:

        - -c
        - |
          set -xe
          yum install jq git wget podman-docker -y
          yum group install "development-tools" -y
          wget https://go.dev/dl/go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
          rm -rf /usr/local/go && tar -C /usr/local -xzf go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
          export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
          go version

          # set +x here to hide pass from log
          set +xe

          echo "podman login with serviceaccount"

          # Used for 4.16 and newer releases.
          pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".auth /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
          pass=`echo ${pass:1:-1} | base64 -d`
          podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:8} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false

          # Used for 4.15 and older releases.
          if ! podman login --get-login image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 &> /dev/null; then
            pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".password /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
            podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:1:-1} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false
          fi

          set -x

          export IMG=PTP_IMAGE
          export DAEMON_IMG="DAEMON_IMAGE"
          export SIDECAR_IMG="SIDECAR_IMAGE"

          export T5CI_VERSION="T5CI_VERSION_VAL"
          export USE_UPSTREAM="USE_UPSTREAM_VAL"

          # run latest release on upstream main branch
          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "Running on upstream main branch"
            git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/ptp-operator.git
          else
            git clone --single-branch --branch OPERATOR_VERSION https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator.git
          fi
          cd ptp-operator
          # OCPBUGS-52327 fix build due to libresolv.so link error
          sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh
          # For UPSTREAM use Dockerfile for upstream contents
          if [[ "$T5CI_VERSION" =~ 4.1[2-8]+ || "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" Dockerfile
            make docker-build
          else
            # Dockerfile is updated to upstream in 4.19+. Use .ocp or .ci versions for non-UPSTREAM runs
            if [ -f "Dockerfile.ocp" ]; then
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ocp"
            else
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ci"
            fi
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" "$DOCKERFILE"
            podman build -t "${IMG}" -f "$DOCKERFILE"
          fi
          podman push ${IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "false" ]]; then
            # If we a running a downstream run we are done
            exit 0

          echo "Running on upstream main branch of linuxptp-daemon"

          IMAGE_TAG_BASE="${DAEMON_IMG%:*}" VERSION="${DAEMON_IMG##*:}" make image
          podman push ${DAEMON_IMG} --tls-verify=false

issues.ai_summary:
---

**TL;DR:** PTP operator absent on bc/dualnicbc/dualnicbcha clusters caused 78 failures; 7 remaining are functional regressions.

**Overall Issue Class:** infra_other
**Overall Severity:** CRITICAL

## Root Causes (85 failures across 4 suites)

### 78/85 failures — PTP operator not deployed on bc, dualnicbc, dualnicbcha clusters
- **Suites:** bc (16), dualnicbc (16), dualnicbcha (46), dualfollower+all+tbc+tgm (partial) | **Evidence:** PROVEN — all suites independently report `deployments.apps "ptp-operator" not found` and `ptpoperatorconfigs.ptp.openshift.io "default" not found`; dualfollower passed identical checks at 02:40 UTC before operator disappeared.
- **What:** The `ptp-operator` Deployment, `ptpoperatorconfigs/default` CR, and `linuxptp-daemon` DaemonSet were absent in `openshift-ptp` namespace for all suite runs after dualfollower (~03:09–04:14 UTC), causing every `[BeforeEach]` to fail with HTTP 404 before any test body executed. The tbc `no T-BC solution found` failure is a confirmed cascade of this same missing-operator state.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown — infrastructure/cluster provisioning failure, not a code regression.
- **Flake?** No — 78 tests fail identically and instantly; dualfollower on same job passed, isolating cluster state as root cause.
- **Fix:** Add a mandatory operator-presence health gate between suite runs and auto-reinstall `ptp-operator` via OLM subscription if absent before each suite starts.

### 1/85 failures — Dual-follower port failover regression
- **Suites:** dualfollower+all+tbc+tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN — `role expected=1(SLAVE), role observed=5(LISTENING)` after full 300s timeout with no progress.
- **What:** After a port-down event, `ens2f1np1` recovered to LISTENING instead of re-entering SLAVE state, indicating the release-5.0 linuxptp-daemon BMCA/port-state recovery logic for dual-follower topology is broken.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown — requires release-5.0 image changelog review for BMCA cherry-pick gaps.
- **Flake?** Unlikely — 300s with zero progress toward SLAVE suggests a real behavioral regression.
- **Fix:** Audit release-5.0 linuxptp-daemon for missing BMCA/port-recovery cherry-picks from main.

### 6/85 failures — TGM functional failures (holdover, ts2phc, events) *(truncated in input)*
- **Suites:** dualfollower+all+tbc+tgm | **Evidence:** HYPOTHESIS — suite analysis was cut off; classified as functional regression by per-suite analysis.
- **What:** GM holdover and ts2phc event logic failures in release-5.0 image, independent of the operator-missing infra issue.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown.
- **Flake?** Unknown — insufficient evidence from truncated analysis.
- **Fix:** Review release-5.0 TGM holdover and event publisher changes against main for regressions.

## Summary Table

| 46 | All PTP tests | dualnicbcha | 1 | infra_other | HIGH | ptp-operator not found on dualnicbcha cluster | Reinstall operator pre-suite |
| 1 | tbc-serial: no T-BC solution | dualfollower+all+tbc+tgm | 1 | infra_other | HIGH | Cascade from missing operator/daemon | Reinstall operator pre-suite |
| 1 | dualfollower port failover | dualfollower+all+tbc+tgm | 2 | test_regression | MEDIUM | BMCA port-state recovery broken in release-5.0 | Cherry-pick BMCA fix to release-5.0 |

## Action Items
1. **Fix cluster provisioning:** Add an operator-presence pre-check gate between every suite run; auto-reinstall `ptp-operator` via OLM if `deployments.apps "ptp-operator" not found` — this alone unblocks 78/85 failures.
2. **Fix release-5.0 image:** Audit linuxptp-daemon release-5.0 for missing BMCA/port-recovery and TGM holdover cherry-picks from main; re-run dualfollower and tgm suites after patch.

  kind: Role
  name: privileged-rights

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: podman
  namespace: openshift-ptp
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  serviceAccountName: builder
  containers:
    - name: priv
      image: quay.io/podman/stable:v4.9.4
      command:
        - /bin/bash
        - -c
        - |
          set -xe
          yum install jq git wget podman-docker -y
          yum group install "development-tools" -y
          wget https://go.dev/dl/go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
          rm -rf /usr/local/go && tar -C /usr/local -xzf go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
          export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
          go version

          # set +x here to hide pass from log
          set +xe

          echo "podman login with serviceaccount"

          # Used for 4.16 and newer releases.
          pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".auth /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
          pass=`echo ${pass:1:-1} | base64 -d`
          podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:8} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false

          # Used for 4.15 and older releases.
          if ! podman login --get-login image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 &> /dev/null; then
            pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".password /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
            podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:1:-1} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false
          fi

          set -x

          export IMG=PTP_IMAGE
          export DAEMON_IMG="DAEMON_IMAGE"
          export SIDECAR_IMG="SIDECAR_IMAGE"

          export T5CI_VERSION="T5CI_VERSION_VAL"
          export USE_UPSTREAM="USE_UPSTREAM_VAL"

          # run latest release on upstream main branch
          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "Running on upstream main branch"
            git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/ptp-operator.git
          else
            git clone --single-branch --branch OPERATOR_VERSION https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator.git
          fi
          cd ptp-operator
          # OCPBUGS-52327 fix build due to libresolv.so link error
          sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh
          # For UPSTREAM use Dockerfile for upstream contents
          if [[ "$T5CI_VERSION" =~ 4.1[2-8]+ || "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" Dockerfile
            make docker-build
          else
            # Dockerfile is updated to upstream in 4.19+. Use .ocp or .ci versions for non-UPSTREAM runs
            if [ -f "Dockerfile.ocp" ]; then
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ocp"
            else
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ci"
            fi
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" "$DOCKERFILE"
            podman build -t "${IMG}" -f "$DOCKERFILE"
          fi
          podman push ${IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "false" ]]; then
            # If we a running a downstream run we are done
            exit 0
          fi

          # If were running upstream we should also use the upstream daemon!
          echo "Running on upstream main branch of linuxptp-daemon"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/linuxptp-daemon.git
          cd linuxptp-daemon
          # Split DAEMON_IMG into IMAGE_TAG_BASE and VERSION because
          # hack/build-image.sh unconditionally overwrites IMG from these two vars.
          IMAGE_TAG_BASE="${DAEMON_IMG%:*}" VERSION="${DAEMON_IMG##*:}" make image
          podman push ${DAEMON_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          echo "Running on main branch of cloud-event-proxy"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/redhat-cne/cloud-event-proxy.git
          cd cloud-event-proxy
          IMG=${SIDECAR_IMG} make podman-build
          podman push ${SIDECAR_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

      securityContext:
        privileged: true
      volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push
          name: dockercfg
          readOnly: true
        - name: secret-volume
          mountPath: /root/.docker
  volumes:
    - name: secret-volume
      secret:
        secretName: pull-secret
        items:
        - key: .dockerconfigjson
          path: config.json

    - name: dockercfg
      secret:
        secretName: BUILDER_DOCKERCFG
        defaultMode: 384
